WORKING NOTES

Try this: Keep the path and grass for a sense of walking motion.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy
honey-blonde hair walks a dirt path through tall
grass. She wears a purple velvet cropped
long-sleeve top with flared cuffs, a black velvet
burnout maxi skirt with a side slit, and a chain belt
with a cross charm. A black choker, layered silver
necklaces, and small hoop earrings complete the
look. Tall black boots show at the hem. Her
expression is calm and direct. Soft, late-afternoon
light and blurred trees. Palette of violet, black, and
sage green. Nostalgic and moody, in the style of a
boho gothic editorial.
